arStrings.szText: {c_important}{u}Charge{/u}{/c} Skills repeat {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} times when Cast at max Stages, each dealing {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%|]{/c} of the original's damage.
{c_important}{u}Charge{/u}{/c} Skills Charge {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|+%|]{/c} faster and deal {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.

Summon a meteor, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT}{/c} damage and Burning the ground for {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_BURNING}{/c} damage over {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds. Channeling increases its damage and area at each Stage by:
{c_gold}I:{/c} {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} damage and {c_number}[{SF_7}*1*100|%|]{/c} area.
{c_gold}II:{/c} {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%|]{/c} damage and {c_number}[{SF_7}*2*100|%|]{/c} area.
{c_gold}III:{/c} {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} damage and {c_number}[{SF_7}*3*100|%|]{/c} area.

{c_important}{u}Combo Finishers{/u}{/c} increase Charge Rate by {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|+%|]{/c}.
